description: This file defines the ClientMessagingOptions class, which specifies global messaging options related to client configuration in the Orleans framework. It includes properties for configuring client-to-gateway communication, such as the number of grain buckets, preferred address family, network interface name, and local IP address.

classes.name: ClientMessagingOptions
classes.description: A class that extends MessagingOptions to include client-specific messaging configuration options, such as bucket count, address family preference, network interface, and local IP address.
